name: step validators from skills
claim: Step bullets of skills extract into validators that validate injected turns, drive policies or structure passively, carrying issues and tags to flows, never blocking (docs/concepts/FLOWS.md F1, QF5).

models.model: none (hand extraction and resolver, by code)
models.result: A3.1, context-experiments skill: 14 of 24 bullets give a checkable shape (58%; 12 strong, 2 weak; 10 none: 5 cross-session, 2 turn-text, 1 judgement, 1 bytes, 1 not-built); 13 of 14 resolve pass or fail on at least one of 101 records (54% of all bullets) but only 3 ever pass, weakly; only 10 records hold call arguments. Not falsified, narrowly. Spec-first skill earlier: 11 of 16.

stage 0, strat-serial-1.0, n=3 (2 parsed): yield per run 13, 0, 11 of 24 (hand 14), median 11; of the 14 hand-shaped it shaped 11, equivalent to the hand shape 4, 0, 3; resolvable 11, 0, 11; cost 0.0072 USD total. Run 2 stopped after 8 tool rounds with no answer; tools were not off.

stage 0, strat-serial-1.0, n=3: yield per run 12, 11, 11 of 24 (hand 14), median 11; of the 14 hand-shaped it shaped 11 each run, equivalent 4, 7, 6 (median 6); resolvable 9, 11, 9; cost 0.0109 USD total. Two runs used 7 and 8 requests (tool rounds); tools were not off.

means: A hand reading of a skill into step validators, fixed with witnesses and decoys before any model runs; the stage-0 baseline.
The fixed evidence kinds a step shape may name: path, command, content, strategy, cache, field, cost; each resolves from named record parts.
A shape that passes on at least one recorded session; resolvable means pass or fail on one, so a shape can resolve and never apply.

model: none (app/validators.js profile reader; spec request to seams)
fault: Content in a turn profile is hashed, so a forbidden content shape (lines 28, 30) passes vacuously and a presence content shape (31, 35, 36) fails falsely, on profile records.
handled: Content shapes are resolved only against traces here; profiles give no pass or fail on content. Seams to decide a content-aware profile or mark content shapes unresolved there. Not changed in app/.

model: none (app/validators.js V.resolve; spec request to seams)
fault: Argument evidence flattens all string leaves, so a path pattern cannot tell a path from content and a forbidden catalog/*.jsonl (line 37) would fire on a read as well as a write.
handled: Disclosed in the results; shapes use kinds path, command, content as hints only. Spec request: tool-name and field-keyed evidence (read vs write). Not changed in app/.

model: none (shape model; spec request to seams)
fault: No group-level (cross-session) validator exists: 5 of the 10 shapeless bullets of the skill (16, 21, 22, 27, 32) are comparisons or counts over sessions.
handled: Counted as shapeless with reason cross-session. Spec request: a group validator kind over a set of sessions. Not implemented.

model: none (app/validators.js, no ledger-kind checks; spec request to seams)
fault: The app has no checks for strategy, cache or session-field evidence; they were resolved by scripts/a3-lib.mjs only. A field shape (resolved, line 25) resolved on 0 of 101 records: no record holds it. No flow_id attribution, so a fail reads not shown.
handled: Ledger kinds resolved in a3-lib.mjs, not in the app. Spec request to seams: ledger-kind checks, a stored resolved field in records, flow attribution.

model: all (OpenRouter qwen/qwen3.7-flash and tencent/hy4-flash ledger rows)
fault: No ledger row records a cache write: 0 of 1435 rows of the A1.1 sessions (1307 have cache reads), so a cache write then read shape (line 24, probe turn) cannot pass on these records.
handled: Reported as fail absent on 93 of 93 ledger records. A probe-turn check needs a provider that reports cache write, or a mock row.

fault: On a one-message extraction task with the session tools left on, run 2 made 8 requests and the harness stopped it after 8 tool rounds with no JSON answer (cost 0.0052 USD, 4x to 7x its other runs). 1 of 3 runs.
handled: Counted as a yield-0 run, not dropped; no rerun (protocol: no prompt change after the first run). The run should be repeated with tools off.

fault: On the same one-message task with tools on it used 7 and 8 requests in 2 of 3 runs (prompt tokens 67k and more) and one request in the third; all three answered with a full JSON array.
handled: Kept as measured; cost was about the same per run. Repeat with tools off.

fault: The A3.1 driver did not switch the session tools off, though the protocol said no tools; the runs carried the harness default tools and made tool rounds. The row holds the request count, not the tools used.
handled: Disclosed in the results note. Resume: set the page tools off in the driver and rerun under a new tag and a new protocol note.

fault: Bash call with Windows backslash paths lost them (C:whsecrets.env read as C:whsecrets.env); in a worktree-isolated agent, git -C, cd and compound or heredoc commands are refused by the isolation guard; the Write tool takes file_path and content.
handled: Use forward slashes in Bash arguments; run plain separate commands from the worktree and use Glob for paths outside it; check parameter names before the call.
